what: The photo cell is covered by 100 vertical bars in the background color (1.1% wide each). When the cell enters the screen, each bar’s top edge drops down with its own delay of 0.01~0.3s and unveils over .9s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1) — the photo is revealed like blind slats falling one by one, a section photo from a hotel/bar site

options.dur: Duration for one bar to clear away (s), default .9
options.spread: Multiplier for the delay step, default 1 (0 to .3s) — 0 plays everything at once
options.ease: Curve (four cubic-bezier numbers or a CSS name), default 0.645,0.045,0.355,1
options.once: If “false,” it covers again when leaving the screen and reveals again on re-entry
options.fx:show · fx:hide: Lifts or covers independent of scroll (e.g. lifting again when advancing a slide)
options.--fx-fill: Bar color (via style), default --kf-bg — if the section background differs, use that color (the original second band is --kf-surface)

from.where: index.html .bh-block__img · bar.html .bh-fu · .bh-row-sec__img .bh-cover (original m-cover — 100 spans width 1.1% · left i%, transition all .9s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1), transition-delay .01 to .3s per nth-child, and when the parent js-view receives is-show from jquery.inview, top 100%)
